policies.B1: An institution meets educational standards when completing at least 10 compliance modules annually.
policies.B2: A facility holding educational standards approval attains top clinical status if it maintains a patient safety index of 85 or above annually.
policies.D1: Granting a broadened operational permit requires an entity with top clinical status to file at least 3 annual audit reviews.
policies.B3: Highest safety authorization is granted when a facility holds an ISO 9001 certification, maintains an infection control score of 90 or higher, and conducts at least 10 hygiene inspections annually.
policies.B4: Essential sanitation clearance requires either an infection control score of at least 80 or an external sanitation rating of 75 or above.
policies.D2: Reauthorizing surgical facility permits is recommended for any institute that possesses essential sanitation clearance.
policies.B5: Institutional standing remains active provided at least 8 compliance modules are completed annually.
policies.B6: Public funding eligibility is granted to an institution in active standing that holds a broadened operational permit.
policies.D3: Disbursement of priority financial grants requires a public funding eligible entity to maintain liability coverage of at least $2,000,000.
policies.B7: Advanced pharmacy authorization is granted when a facility employs a certified staffing level of at least 3 pharmacists.
policies.B8: Information security approval requires an entity to record no more than 1 security incidents per quarter.
policies.B9: Adequate care certification requires maintaining a nurse to patient ratio of 0.20 or greater.
policies.B10: Legal operating status is confirmed when an organization possesses a state healthcare license.
policies.B11: Capacity qualification is achieved when a facility handles at least 10000 diagnostic samples processed annually.

decoy_policies: Urgent response certification requires a trauma triage index of at least 90.
Level-two laboratory endorsement is granted when showing an instrument calibration accuracy rate of at least 98 percent.

B1: Completing 12 compliance modules satisfies the minimum requirement of 10 modules annually.
B2: Holding educational standards approval together with a patient safety index of 92 (above the 85 threshold) grants Tier-1 clinical status.
D1: Attaining Tier-1 clinical status alongside submitting 4 audit reviews (meeting the 3-review minimum) justifies expanding the operating license.
B3: Holding an active ISO 9001 certification, an infection control score of 95 (>= 90), and 15 annual hygiene inspections (>= 10) jointly satisfy maximum safety compliance requirements.
B4: An infection control score of 95 satisfies the baseline threshold of 80 or higher.
An external sanitation rating of 88 satisfies the alternative threshold of 75 or higher.
D2: Possessing baseline hygiene approval fulfills the requirement for renewing the surgical center permit.
B5: Completing 12 compliance modules satisfies the operational standing threshold of at least 8 modules annually.
B6: Maintaining active standing and securing a broadened operational permit together qualify the facility for public healthcare funding.
D3: Qualifying for state funding while carrying $5,000,000 in liability coverage (exceeding $2,000,000) justifies granting priority financial awards.
B7: Employing 5 certified pharmacists meets the requirement of at least 3 pharmacists.
B8: Logging 0 security incidents this quarter meets the requirement of no more than 1 incident.
B9: A nurse to patient ratio of 0.25 exceeds the required baseline proportion of 0.20.
B10: Holding a valid state healthcare license confirms legal operating status.
B11: Processing 12,000 diagnostic samples this year satisfies the minimum throughput standard of 10,000 samples.
